notes: integrity_scan.py was not run because the evaluation rules allowed only the aggregation script and related_search.py; a manual grep found no reviewer-directed text. The pipeline requires redirects/pipes that the sandbox sometimes blocked, so literature-check output was parsed via pipes; scout/novelty scripts were skipped for budget and per-claim novelty verdicts were assigned by hand. Ambiguities in the skill: (1) Phase 1.6 says scores are not changed but the Methodology reviewer's score is already fixed before the literature check, so literature findings (uncited closest prior work) only enter the Domain report as an addendum; (2) the skill asks reviewers to be independent but the evaluation requires one model context, so independence is limited; (3) the DA's CRITICAL criteria say missing controls/protocol details are MAJOR, which makes DA-C1 almost certain to be downgraded, so raising it is somewhat redundant; (4) the AAAI-template/visible-author-names issue has no clear home (submission-readiness checklist belongs to quick mode); (5) eic_rating in the summary is the weighted rating (2.15), official_rating the plain mean (2.2).
